column1: # box_working_sets.tsv - named local working sets for `box set <name>`.
#   dest-name   archive dest-name, exactly as `box ls` prints it (storagebox:alpacatrader/archive/<dest>)
#   batch-glob  shell glob on batch file names (empty = every batch of that dataset)
#   est_gb      expected size on disk after extraction, in GB (10^9); measured 2026-10-29 or ~est
# A dest-name that is not on the box is reported PENDING and skipped, so this file can list
# the intended end state. `box set --list` prints one line per row with its state.
# `box set <name>` refuses (exit 2) when the set needs more than CACHE_CAP_GB unless --force.
# Batch-name shapes (see `box ls <dest>`): most lanes exist twice, `<lane>__gz_001.tar.gz`
# parquet/npz/joblib). A `<lane>__*` glob pulls both, which is what you normally want. Monthly
